sentence: Some research groups are discussing a newer name, polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS), for the condition long called PCOS. This hub keeps the PCOS name until Women's Health Duo clinicians confirm that wording. The longer explanation is on the what-is-PCOS page.
